# HEM v0.6.2b8 — Searchable, simpler settings menus

- Home, Room and Device menus now have a setting search and a UI-only Show advanced settings toggle. Search includes Advanced controls, help text and entity IDs.
- Specialist PID/model tuning, PMV inputs, reference values, compatibility tuning and optional door diagnostics move to Advanced. Methods, targets, sources, occupancy, minimum ON/OFF, maximum runtime, watchdog, window protection and explicit recovery/calibration actions remain in the normal view.
- Three proven duplicate Home editors are consolidated with their existing Options fields: source age, away cooldown and household presence policy. Native entities, automation references and saved values remain intact; native fallback remains when the Options form is unavailable.
- Pending or failed edits remain visible through filtering. No setting is changed by searching or changing the display tier. Existing direct autosave, confirmation, concise labels and door/Eco ordering are retained.
- Keep the small Floor form unchanged. No extra settings categories, automatic tuning, settings deletion or configuration reset.
- Include a reproducible catalog inventory and a source-verified decision document. Catalog entries are not counts of controls displayed. The separate Deep Research report was unavailable; destructive removals and exhaustive legacy-consumer conclusions are not claimed.

Backend control, safety, defaults, PID, permissions and Announcement Hub routing are unchanged. Update through HACS, follow its reload prompt and fully refresh the dashboard. The release process does not install on or restart your server.
